data.one_liner: Linter plugin that enforces correct usage of freezed classes.
data.what_it_does: Provides two lints: one for missing mixin and one for missing private empty constructor. Quick‑fixes generate the correct code. It runs as an analyzer plugin, so no build_runner is required.
use_when: You use freezed for immutable data classes and want to catch common mistakes early
You want IDE or command‑line feedback on missing mixins or constructors
avoid_when: You are not using freezed in your project
You prefer custom lint rules written in a different framework
strengths: No build_runner or code generation needed
Works out of the box with Dart 3.10+
weaknesses: No support for other code‑gen libraries
data.setup_notes: Add `freezed_lint` under the `plugins` section of analysis_options.yaml. No pubspec dependency is needed.
